description:
Hi, I'm Ray Dutton, a retired HVAC pro. I show homeowners how to keep their furnace, heat pump and air conditioner running without getting robbed.

For twenty-five years I worked in attics, basements and crawlspaces for the same companies I now expose, so I know what a twelve dollar part looks like on a four hundred dollar invoice.

Here you'll learn what really goes wrong with your heating and cooling, from the thermostat on the wall to the filter, the ducts and the furnace itself. I'll show you what you can check and fix yourself for a few dollars, what the bill should really be when you do need help, and how to spot a repair or replacement you don't need. No scare tactics, no upsells.

Winter or summer, new videos every week to keep your house comfortable and your money in your pocket.

Get my HVAC Survival Guide: https://raydutton.com

Subscribe if you'd rather fix it than finance it.
